posts.description: One of my bigger hobbies I spend time on is reading: books, blogs, newspapers: I like all of them. posts.title: Loops and Goals in Claude Code
posts.description: Two commands not mentioned in the Claude Code Commands Cheatsheet are /loop and /goal . They deserve a closer look as they can keep Claude working without prompting every turn and enable the creation of personal automations. /loop runs on a schedule and /goal runs until a condition is met. /goal : run until it is done The /goal command can be used to set a goal for Claude. Claude runs immediately
